name: Online Ruler
description: Measure anything on your screen with pixel-perfect accuracy. A lightweight browser-based ruler for U.S. designers and developers using standard NIST-defined units.
longDescription: Online Ruler provides instant, accurate measurements directly in your browser. No downloads, no sign-ups. Just open, measure, and get results. Primary U.S. measurement options include inches (in) with 1/16", 1/8", 1/4", and 1/2" fractions, paired cleanly with millimeters (mm), centimeters (cm), and pixels (px). Calibration references the standard U.S. credit/debit card and driver's license (ISO/IEC 7810 ID-1: 3.370 × 2.125 inches / 85.60 × 53.98 mm) and the NIST exact definition (1 international inch = 25.4 millimeters exactly; https://www.nist.gov/pml/owm/metric-si/si-units-length).
pricingDetails: Completely free with no limitations. No account required. $0 versus $12–$29/month single-purpose SaaS measurement tools.
features: Inches (in) with 1/16", 1/8", 1/4", and 1/2" fraction marks — primary U.S. option
Centimeters (cm), millimeters (mm), and pixels (px) for clean metric pairing
Calibration using standard U.S. bank/ID card (ISO/IEC 7810 ID-1: 3.370 × 2.125 in / 85.60 × 53.98 mm)
NIST exact definition reference (1 international inch = 25.4 mm exactly)
No installation required; runs instantly in Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge, and Brave
Works across Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS with responsive layout
useCases: U.S. UI/UX design measurement (U.S. Letter 8.5 × 11 in assets, screen mockups)
Frontend development with inch and pixel measurements
Print design verification for U.S. standard paper sizes
Quick screen measurements on mobile 5G and broadband connections
